relationships.subject: Gepants
relationships.evidence_quote: CGRP-targeted therapy includes monoclonal antibodies (mAbs) and gepants, which modulate trigeminal nociceptive and inflammatory responses, alleviating pain sensitization involved in migraine pathogenesis.

relationships.subject: Monoclonal antibodies targeting CGRP
relationships.evidence_quote: CGRP-targeted therapy is effective not only for migraine but also for other chronic headache disorders that share the CGRP pathway.

key_findings: CGRP-targeted mAbs and gepants can generally be combined safely.
